summary: Controlled 0–10 scale for a recommendation question.
whenToUse: Collecting a numeric NPS response to be processed by the consumer.
whenNotToUse: For star ratings use Rating; the NPS score is not calculated here.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected value from 0 to 10, or null.

keyboard.action: Navigates and selects a value via RadioGroup.

accessibility: The question names the radio group; each value has a numeric accessible name.
responsive: The scale can wrap on narrow viewports and containers.
customization: The radio group uses design system components and tokens.
commonMistakes: Interpreting the selected value as an aggregate score.
limits: No calculation, submission or tracking included.
